title: Laumufarþegi page use cases
description: What the host and the players do with the page, step by step. The page only shows the room's views and sends actions; the rules the steps rely on are in shared/, and the routes and the room in worker/.

entities.name: Start a room and its game
entities.description: The host makes a room, shares its link, sets the game up and starts it once enough players are in.
entities.goal: Get a game going with the people they want to play with, each on their own device.
preconditions: The home page is open (no ?r= in the address).
The host is signed in to icelander.net with the games:play role, unless HOST_SIGN_IN is none.
postconditions: A room exists under a new five-letter code, with the host's seat; its token is in the host's localStorage.
The address is BASE/?r=CODE, the link the others need.
Once started, the room is in its first round.

flow.action: Asks api/me whether this visitor may start a room, and fills in their signed-in name when the name field is empty.
Types or keeps their name and presses Stofna nýjan leik.
POSTs the name to api/rooms, keeps the returned token for the room's code, puts ?r=CODE in the address and connects to the room with the token.
Shows the lobby: the code, the share link with a copy button, the players as they join, and the settings the host may change.
Copies the link (Afrita hlekk) and pastes it where the others will see it, for example a Teams chat.
Optionally sets the number of rounds, the seconds per clue and for the vote, the topics' difficulty and child-friendly topics only.
Presses Byrja leikinn once at least three players are connected.
Draws the round screen from the first round's view.

alternatives.condition: The visitor may not start a room.
alternatives.outcome: The page says so with a link to sign in, and that the others join from the link without signing in.

alternatives.condition: The name is empty.
alternatives.outcome: A message asks for it; nothing is sent.

alternatives.condition: The server answers 401.
alternatives.outcome: Its message is shown with a sign-in link.

alternatives.condition: Any other failure (no free code, a server error).
alternatives.outcome: The server's message, or a general one, is shown briefly; the host may try again.

alternatives.condition: Fewer than three players are connected.
alternatives.outcome: The button is disabled and counts the players connected; the room would refuse the start too.

entities.name: Join a room from its link
entities.description: A player opens the shared link, gives a name and takes a seat, with no sign-in.
entities.goal: Get into the game their colleagues or friends are about to play.
preconditions: The player has the room's link (BASE/?r=CODE) or its five letters.
The room exists and has fewer than ten players.
postconditions: The player has a seat in the room, and its token is in their localStorage, so a reload takes the same seat.
They see the lobby, or the round under way.

flow.action: Opens the link.
With no token stored for this room, shows the room's code and asks for a name, filled in with the last one used.
Types a name and presses Ganga í leikinn.
Opens the room's WebSocket and sends join with the name; on welcome, keeps the seat's token.
Shows the lobby with the players and the settings, and waits for the host to start.

alternatives.condition: The player has only the code.
alternatives.outcome: They type it on the home page under Ganga í leik; anything but five code letters is refused with a message.

alternatives.condition: A token for this room is already stored (a reload, or the host's own device).
alternatives.outcome: The page reconnects with the token straight to the same seat.

alternatives.condition: The name is taken or the room is full.
alternatives.outcome: The room's reason is shown and the name entry comes back.

alternatives.condition: The room no longer exists.
alternatives.outcome: The socket is closed with 4404, the stored token is dropped and the page says the game is gone.

alternatives.condition: A round is already under way.
alternatives.outcome: The player watches it without the secret word and is dealt into the next round.

alternatives.condition: The connection drops later.
alternatives.outcome: The page shows that it is reconnecting and tries again, waiting longer each time, with the stored token.

entities.name: Play a round
entities.description: A player in the round gives a clue, votes for the stowaway and sees how the round went.
entities.goal: Find the stowaway without giving the word away, or, as the stowaway, pass unnoticed; and score points.
preconditions: The player has a seat and was connected when the round was dealt.
postconditions: The round's points are added to every player's score.
Everyone has seen the secret word, the stowaway, the votes and the points.

flow.action: Shows the topic's 16 words and the player's role: the secret word, marked in the grid, or that they are the stowaway.
When the page says it is their turn, types one short clue and sends it before the countdown ends.
Shows each player's clue as it comes, and whose turn it is.
Votes for one of the others, each shown with their clue, and may change the vote until everyone has voted.
Shows the stowaway, the secret word, the verdict, everyone's vote and the round's points, and the scores so far.

alternatives.condition: The clue is the secret word itself, from a player who knows it.
alternatives.outcome: The room refuses it and the page shows why; the player tries another.

alternatives.condition: The countdown ends first.
alternatives.outcome: The clue is recorded as "—" and the next player's turn begins.

alternatives.condition: The vote catches the stowaway, and this player is the stowaway.
alternatives.outcome: The page says they were caught and makes the grid's words buttons; they pick one as their guess before the countdown ends.

alternatives.condition: The vote catches the stowaway, and this player is someone else.
alternatives.outcome: The page names the stowaway, who is now guessing.

alternatives.condition: The player is not in this round (they joined during it).
alternatives.outcome: They see the grid and the clues without the secret word and do not vote.

entities.name: Run the game to its end
entities.description: The host moves from round to round, removes a player if need be, and ends the game.
entities.goal: Play the number of rounds chosen, see who won, and play again if the group wants.
preconditions: The host's seat is the room's host, and a game has started.
postconditions: The game is over and everyone sees the final standings and the winner, or winners on a tie.

flow.action: At each round's reveal, presses Næsta umferð; after the last round, Sjá lokastöðu.
Shows the final standings and the winners, the settings, and to the host a button for a new game with the same players.

alternatives.condition: The host wants to stop before the last round.
alternatives.outcome: Ljúka leik, confirmed, ends the game; a round under way is not scored.

alternatives.condition: Someone should leave the room.
alternatives.outcome: The host removes them from the player list, after confirming; the room refuses while that player is in the round being played. The removed player's page says so.

alternatives.condition: Fewer than three players are connected for the next round.
alternatives.outcome: The room refuses and the host is told why.

alternatives.condition: The group wants another game.
alternatives.outcome: The host starts a new one: scores back to 0, the first round dealt.

entities.name: Take over from a host who has gone
entities.description: When the host's device has been disconnected for 30 seconds, another player takes over the room.
entities.goal: Keep the game going without the host.
preconditions: The player has a seat; the host has been disconnected for at least 30 seconds.
postconditions: The player is the room's host, with the host's buttons; the old host plays on as an ordinary player if they come back.

flow.action: Says the host is not connected and offers Taka við stjórninni.
Presses it.

alternatives.condition: The host has reconnected, or another player claimed first.
alternatives.outcome: The room refuses with a reason, or the offer disappears with the next view.
